title: SET OF 2 Coca-Cola Girl Old Fashioned Archive Brown Tan 16oz Re-Creation
descriptionText: SET OF 2 Coca-Cola Girl Old Fashioned Archive Brown Tan 16oz Re-Creation features a vintage design with a Coca-Cola theme. The drinking glasses are a reproduction of an old-fashioned style, showcasing the iconic Coca-Cola brand in brown color. Each glass has a 16oz capacity and is adorned with an image of the Coca-Cola girl, offering a nostalgic touch to your collection.
